add-red-rectangle-annotation.title: Add Red Rectangle Annotation with 2 mm Border to PDF Page
add-red-rectangle-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create a red square (rectangle) annotation with a 2 mm border thickness, add it to a specific page, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-highlight-annotation-to-pdf-page.title: Add Highlight Annotation to PDF Page
add-highlight-annotation-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to insert a highlight annotation over a specific text range on page three of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-sticky-note-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add Sticky Note Annotation to First PDF Page
add-sticky-note-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to place a sticky‑note (text) annotation with a user comment on the first page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-bookmark-to-pdf-page.title: Add Bookmark to PDF Navigating to Page 5
add-bookmark-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF, verify it has at least five pages, create an outline bookmark that jumps to page 5, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

create-nested-bookmarks-pdf.title: Add Nested Bookmarks to PDF
create-nested-bookmarks-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a parent bookmark (Chapter One) with child section bookmarks using OutlineItemCollection and GoToAction, then save the updated PDF.

add-javascript-click-action-to-pdf-recta.title: Add Rectangle Annotation to PDF
add-javascript-click-action-to-pdf-recta.description: Loads a PDF, creates a red square (rectangle) annotation on the first page, configures its border, and saves the updated document. The code also notes that a newer Aspose.Pdf version is required to attach JavaScript actions.

add-javascript-calculation-button-to-pdf.title: Add JavaScript Calculation Button to PDF Form
add-javascript-calculation-button-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a push‑button on a PDF form, attach JavaScript that multiplies Quantity and UnitPrice fields, and write the result to a Total field.

extract-first-image-from-pdf-page2-png.title: Extract First Image from PDF Page
extract-first-image-from-pdf-page2-png.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract the first image on page 2 of a PDF and save it as a PNG file.

add-image-stamp-to-bottom-right-page-3.title: Add Logo Image Stamp to Bottom‑Right of Page 3
add-image-stamp-to-bottom-right-page-3.description: Demonstrates how to create an ImageStamp from a PNG file and place it at the bottom‑right corner of the third page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-confidential-text-stamp.title: Create Red Confidential Text Stamp with Semi‑Transparent Background
add-confidential-text-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to create a red "Confidential" text stamp with a semi‑transparent background and apply it to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

reposition-stamp-left-margin.title: Reposition Stamp on Page 4 to Left Margin
reposition-stamp-left-margin.description: Shows how to extract page 4, move an existing stamp annotation 10 mm from the left edge, and reinsert the modified page back into the original PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-text-in-pdf.title: Replace 'Draft' with 'Final' in a PDF
replace-text-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, replace every occurrence of the word "Draft" with "Final", and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

replace-invoicenumber-with-uuid-page-6.title: Replace Text with UUID on Specific PDF Page
replace-invoicenumber-with-uuid-page-6.description: Shows how to load a PDF, generate a UUID, and replace a case‑sensitive string on page 6 using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

set-pdf-viewer-preference-and-default-zo.title: Set PDF Viewer Preferences for Single Page Layout and 100% Zoom
set-pdf-viewer-preference-and-default-zo.description: The example loads a PDF, configures the viewer preferences to display pages in a single‑column continuous layout and sets the default zoom to 100 %, then saves the modified document.

get-pdf-viewer-preferences-zoom.title: Read PDF Viewer Preferences (Page Layout and Zoom)
get-pdf-viewer-preferences-zoom.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, access the ViewerPreferences to log page layout, zoom mode, and custom zoom factor, and gracefully handle library versions that lack the property.

remove-embedded-file-from-pdf.title: Remove Embedded Attachment from PDF
remove-embedded-file-from-pdf.description: Shows how to locate and delete a specific embedded file (e.g., OldReport.pdf) from a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf and save the modified file.

password-protect-pdf-disable-printing.title: Password Protect PDF and Disable Printing
password-protect-pdf-disable-printing.description: Loads a PDF, applies user and owner passwords, configures permissions to allow editing while disabling printing, and saves the protected document.

set-pdf-permissions-allow-copy-restrict-.title: Allow Text Extraction While Restricting Form Editing and Annotations
set-pdf-permissions-allow-copy-restrict-.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, granting the ExtractContent permission so users can copy text, while preventing form field edits and annotation changes.

add-xmp-metadata-author-title.title: Add XMP Author and Title Metadata to PDF
add-xmp-metadata-author-title.description: This example shows how to set the Author and Title fields in a PDF's XMP metadata using Aspose.Pdf. It loads a PDF, updates the DocumentInfo properties, and saves the result.

update-pdf-xmp-metadata-custom-project-s.title: Update PDF XMP Metadata with Custom Project Schema
update-pdf-xmp-metadata-custom-project-s.description: Demonstrates how to add custom XMP metadata entries (ProjectID and Version) to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's Metadata dictionary and save the updated document.

fill-acroform-text-field.title: Fill AcroForm Text Field Using Aspose.Pdf
fill-acroform-text-field.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, locating an AcroForm text field named 'CustomerName', setting its value to 'Acme Corporation', and saving the updated document.

set-checkbox-field-in-pdf-form.title: Set Checkbox Field to True in PDF Form
set-checkbox-field-in-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, locate a checkbox form field by name, set it to checked, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

set-radio-button-value-in-pdf-acroform.title: Set Express Shipping Radio Button in PDF AcroForm
set-radio-button-value-in-pdf-acroform.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, locating a radio‑button field in the AcroForm, setting its value to the "Express" option, and saving the updated document.

convert-pdf-page-to-high-res-png.title: Convert PDF Page 7 to 300 DPI PNG
convert-pdf-page-to-high-res-png.description: Loads a PDF, extracts the seventh page, and renders it as a high‑resolution PNG image at 300 DPI using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff-lzw.title: Convert PDF to Multi‑Page TIFF with LZW Compression
convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff-lzw.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF document and convert the entire file into a multi‑page TIFF image using Aspose.Pdf's PdfConverter with LZW compression.

convert-jpeg-to-pdf.title: Convert JPEG Image to Single-Page PDF
convert-jpeg-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a JPEG file, add it to a new PDF page, and save the result as a single‑page PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

print-pdf-multiple-copies-landscape.title: Print PDF to Default Printer with Multiple Copies and Landscape Orientation
print-pdf-multiple-copies-landscape.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, binding it to PdfPrintHelper, and sending two landscape copies to the system's default printer.

batch-add-red-rectangle-annotation.title: Batch Add Red Rectangle Annotation to PDFs
batch-add-red-rectangle-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to loop through all PDF files in a folder and add a red rectangular (square) annotation to the first page of each document, saving the result with a new name.

batch-replace-confidential-with-public.title: Batch Replace Confidential with Public in PDFs
batch-replace-confidential-with-public.description: Shows how to loop through PDF files in a folder and use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfContentEditor to replace every occurrence of "Confidential" with "Public", saving the modified files to an output directory.

batch-apply-js-alert-to-rectangle-annota.title: Batch Add JavaScript Alert to Rectangle Annotations
batch-apply-js-alert-to-rectangle-annota.description: Shows how to process multiple PDF files, locate rectangle (square) annotations on each page, and attach a JavaScript alert action (or placeholder) to them in batch.

batch-set-pdf-viewer-preference-fullscre.title: Set PDF Viewer Preference to Full‑Screen for All Files in a Directory
batch-set-pdf-viewer-preference-fullscre.description: Shows how to loop through PDF files in a folder, set the viewer preference so each document opens in full‑screen mode, and save the changes back to the original files using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-add-password-protection-to-pdfs.title: Batch Add Password Protection to PDFs
batch-add-password-protection-to-pdfs.description: Shows how to iterate through a folder of PDF files and apply the same user password to each document using Aspose.Pdf encryption.

convert-pdf-pages-to-transparent-png.title: Convert PDF Pages to Transparent PNG Images at 150 DPI
convert-pdf-pages-to-transparent-png.description: Shows how to batch convert each page of a PDF into separate PNG files with a transparent background and 150 DPI using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-reposition-stamps-top-center.title: Batch Reposition Stamps to Top‑Center of PDF Pages
batch-reposition-stamps-top-center.description: Shows how to process multiple PDF files, locate stamp annotations on each page, and move them to the top‑center of the page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-hyperlink-annotation-to-pdf-page.title: Add Hyperlink Annotation to PDF Page
add-hyperlink-annotation-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to insert a clickable link annotation on a specific PDF page that opens a URL using Aspose.Pdf.

add-javascript-calculate-action-to-pdf-f.title: Add JavaScript Calculation to PDF Form Field
add-javascript-calculate-action-to-pdf-f.description: Shows how to attach a JavaScript action to a PDF form field with Aspose.Pdf so the Total field is automatically computed when the Quantity value changes.

extract-page5-images-grayscale.title: Extract Images from PDF Page and Convert to Grayscale JPEG
extract-page5-images-grayscale.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from a specific PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, converting each image to grayscale, and saving the result as JPEG files.

center-image-stamp-on-page-8.title: Center Image Stamp on Page 8 of a PDF
center-image-stamp-on-page-8.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create an ImageStamp, calculate its centered position, and add it to page 8 using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-text-in-pdf-annotations.title: Replace Text in PDF Annotations on Selected Pages
replace-text-in-pdf-annotations.description: Demonstrates how to iterate specific pages of a PDF and replace the contents of text annotations using Aspose.Pdf.

hide-toolbar-and-menubar-viewer-preferen.title: Set PDF Viewer Preferences to Hide Toolbar and Menubar
hide-toolbar-and-menubar-viewer-preferen.description: Demonstrates how to hide the toolbar and menu bar in PDF viewers by setting the ViewerPreferences of an Aspose.Pdf Document, using reflection to stay compatible with different library versions.

delete-pdf-attachments-matching-old-pdf.title: Remove Attachments Matching Pattern from PDF
delete-pdf-attachments-matching-old-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, locate embedded file attachments whose names end with a specific pattern ("_old.pdf"), delete those attachments, and save the updated document.

encrypt-pdf-128-aes-restrict-permissions.title: Encrypt PDF with 128‑bit AES and Restrict Editing/Printing
encrypt-pdf-128-aes-restrict-permissions.description: Demonstrates how to apply 128‑bit AES encryption to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while disabling editing and printing by setting no permissions.

add-custom-xmp-metadata-projectid.title: Add Custom XMP Metadata to PDF
add-custom-xmp-metadata-projectid.description: Shows how to add or update a custom XMP metadata field (ProjectID) and also store it in the PDF's Info dictionary so it appears in the document properties UI using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-to-page-three-50mm.title: Add Base64 Image Stamp to PDF Page
add-image-stamp-to-page-three-50mm.description: Demonstrates how to decode a Base64‑encoded image, create an ImageStamp, and place it on the third page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

create-multiline-text-stamp.title: Add Multiline Text Stamp to PDF Pages
create-multiline-text-stamp.description: Shows how to create a multiline text stamp with Arial 14 pt blue font and apply it to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json.title: Fill PDF Form Fields from JSON
fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json.description: Shows how to load a PDF, read a JSON file that maps form field names to values, and populate the PDF form fields using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-pages-to-png-transparent.title: Convert PDF Pages to Transparent PNG Images
convert-pdf-pages-to-png-transparent.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, setting a 200 DPI resolution, enabling transparent background, and exporting selected pages (2‑4) as PNG files.

silently-print-pdf-to-network-printer.title: Print PDF Silently to Network Printer
silently-print-pdf-to-network-printer.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfViewer and send it directly to a network printer using printer settings without any user interaction.

add-dashed-rectangle-annotation-with-opa.title: Add Dashed Rectangle Annotation to PDF Page
add-dashed-rectangle-annotation-with-opa.description: Shows how to place a rectangle (square) annotation with a dashed border and 50% opacity on a specific page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-open-javascript-log-page-number.title: Add JavaScript to Log Page Number on Open
add-page-open-javascript-log-page-number.description: Shows how to attach a JavaScript action to each PDF page that logs the current page number to the console when the page is opened, using Aspose.Pdf.

generate-pdf-catalog-of-extracted-images.title: Generate PDF Image Catalog with Thumbnails
generate-pdf-catalog-of-extracted-images.description: Extracts all images from an existing PDF using PdfExtractor and creates a new PDF where each image is placed as a centered thumbnail on its own page.

reposition-stamp-to-baseline-page-5.title: Align Image Stamp with Text Baseline on Page 5
reposition-stamp-to-baseline-page-5.description: The example loads a PDF, determines the baseline position of the first text fragment on page 5, and places an image stamp so that its lower edge aligns with that baseline.

replace-dates-in-pdf-using-regex.title: Replace MM/DD/YYYY Dates with YYYY-MM-DD in PDF
replace-dates-in-pdf-using-regex.description: Demonstrates how to use PdfContentEditor to locate dates in MM/DD/YYYY format with a regular expression and replace them with ISO YYYY‑MM‑DD format in a PDF document.

set-pdf-viewer-preferences-fit-width.title: Set PDF Viewer Preferences for Thumbnails Pane and Fit Width Zoom
set-pdf-viewer-preferences-fit-width.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF with the thumbnails pane visible and the default zoom set to fit width using Aspose.Pdf. The code uses reflection to stay compatible with older library versions that may not expose ViewerPreferences directly.

update-pdf-xmp-creator-metadata.title: Edit PDF XMP Creator Metadata
update-pdf-xmp-creator-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to extract XMP metadata from a PDF, change the dc:creator field, and write the updated metadata back to the document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-encrypted-attachment-aes256.title: Add Encrypted AES Attachment to PDF
add-encrypted-attachment-aes256.description: Demonstrates encrypting a file with AES‑256 and embedding it as an attachment in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, including a custom description field for the attachment.

remove-all-bookmarks-from-pdf.title: Remove All Bookmarks from PDF
remove-all-bookmarks-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to delete every bookmark in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfBookmarkEditor facade and save the cleaned document.

create-nested-pdf-bookmarks.title: Create Three-Level Bookmarks in PDF
create-nested-pdf-bookmarks.description: Shows how to add a hierarchical bookmark structure (section, subsection, sub‑subsection) to an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-underlined-text-stamp-to-page-ten.title: Add Centered Underlined Text Stamp with Yellow Background to PDF Page
add-underlined-text-stamp-to-page-ten.description: Shows how to create a TextStamp with underline, yellow background and centered alignment, and apply it to the 10th page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-pages-to-bmp.title: Convert PDF Pages to 24-bit BMP Images
convert-pdf-pages-to-bmp.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and render each page as a 24‑bit BMP file using BmpDevice.

print-pdf-duplex-collated-copies.title: Print PDF with Duplex Mode and Collated Copies
print-pdf-duplex-collated-copies.description: Shows how to print a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades with duplex (double‑sided) printing enabled and multiple collated copies.

add-rectangle-annotation-light-gray.title: Add Rectangle Annotation with Light Gray Fill
add-rectangle-annotation-light-gray.description: Demonstrates how to add a rectangle (square) annotation to a PDF page, set a light‑gray interior fill color, and apply a 1 pt solid border using Aspose.Pdf.

add-javascript-validation-button-to-pdf-.title: Add Validation JavaScript to PDF Form
add-javascript-validation-button-to-pdf-.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF, attach a JavaScript action that checks required form fields and shows an alert if any are empty, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-external-url-bookmark-to-pdf.title: Add Bookmark with External URL to PDF
add-external-url-bookmark-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create an outline bookmark in a PDF that opens an external web page when selected, using Aspose.Pdf.

hide-scrollbars-disable-page-transitions.title: Hide Scrollbars and Remove Page Transitions in PDF
hide-scrollbars-disable-page-transitions.description: Loads a PDF, clears any page transition effects using PdfPageEditor, and sets viewer preferences to hide scrollbars (and other UI elements) before saving the modified document.

extract-viewer-preferences-to-json.title: Extract PDF Viewer Preferences to JSON
extract-viewer-preferences-to-json.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, read its ViewerPreferences (page layout and zoom), and write these settings to a JSON configuration file.

add-attachment-set-modification-date.title: Add File Attachment with UTC Modification Date to PDF
add-attachment-set-modification-date.description: Demonstrates attaching a file to a PDF page and setting the attachment's modification date to the current UTC timestamp using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-specific-bookmark-from-pdf.title: Remove Specific Bookmark from PDF
remove-specific-bookmark-from-pdf.description: Shows how to locate a bookmark (outline) by title and delete it from a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-with-certificate-signature.title: Certificate‑Based PDF Encryption with Permissions
encrypt-pdf-with-certificate-signature.description: The example loads a PDF and a PKCS#12 certificate, then applies AES‑256 certificate‑based encryption with specific permissions and saves the encrypted document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-text-stamp-with-shadow.title: Add Text Stamp with Shadow to PDF
add-text-stamp-with-shadow.description: Demonstrates how to place a text stamp with a shadow effect at the top of the first page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-from-stream.title: Add In-Memory Image Stamp to PDF
add-image-stamp-from-stream.description: Demonstrates creating an ImageStamp directly from a MemoryStream containing a PNG image and applying it to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, without saving the image to disk.

convert-pdf-to-jpeg-150-dpi.title: Convert PDF Pages to JPEG Images with 150 DPI
convert-pdf-to-jpeg-150-dpi.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and save each page as a JPEG image using a 150 DPI resolution and high quality suitable for web use.

convert-png-to-multi-page-pdf.title: Convert PNG Images to Multi‑Page PDF
convert-png-to-multi-page-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to read a folder of PNG files, create a new PDF document, add each image as a full‑page image, and save the result as a multi‑page PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-semi-transparent-file-attachment-ann.title: Add Semi-Transparent Text Annotation to PDF Page
add-semi-transparent-file-attachment-ann.description: Shows how to place a TextAnnotation with 60% opacity on the third page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-images-from-pdf-rename-by-page-i.title: Extract Images from PDF with Page and Index Naming
extract-images-from-pdf-rename-by-page-i.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, extract embedded images, and save them with filenames that include the page number and image index.

replace-text-preserve-style.title: Replace Text While Preserving Formatting in PDF
replace-text-preserve-style.description: Demonstrates how to replace occurrences of a string in a PDF while keeping the original font style, size, and color using Aspose.Pdf's PdfContentEditor.

add-file-attachment-data-relationship.title: Add Attachment with Data Relationship to PDF
add-file-attachment-data-relationship.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and set its AFRelationship to Data for better document organization.

add-corporate-branding-xmp-metadata.title: Add XMP Corporate Branding Metadata to PDF
add-corporate-branding-xmp-metadata.description: Shows how to embed custom XMP metadata—including a logo URL and brand color—into a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multiline-right-aligned-text-stamp-p.title: Add Right-Aligned Multiline Text Stamp to PDF Page
add-multiline-right-aligned-text-stamp-p.description: Demonstrates how to create a multiline TextStamp, align it to the right and bottom of a page, and apply it to page four of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-png-thumbnails-300-dpi.title: Convert PDF Pages to PNG Thumbnails with 300 DPI and Transparent Background
convert-pdf-to-png-thumbnails-300-dpi.description: Loads a PDF document and renders each page to a PNG image at 300 DPI with a transparent background, saving the results as thumbnail files.

combine-jpeg-images-to-pdf.title: Merge JPEG Images into a PDF
combine-jpeg-images-to-pdf.description: Shows how to combine multiple JPEG files into a single PDF document, adding each image to a separate page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-rectangle-annotation-with-dash-opaci.title: Add Rectangle Annotation with Custom Dash Pattern and Opacity
add-rectangle-annotation-with-dash-opaci.description: Demonstrates how to add a square (rectangle) annotation to the first page of a PDF, set its border color, fill color, 75% opacity, and apply a custom dash pattern.

add-submit-button-confirmation-dialog.title: Add Confirmation Dialog JavaScript to PDF Form
add-submit-button-confirmation-dialog.description: Demonstrates embedding a JavaScript confirmation dialog that runs before submitting a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-url-bookmark-to-pdf.title: Add Help Bookmark with URL to PDF
add-url-bookmark-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create an outline bookmark named "Help" that opens an external documentation URL when clicked, and add it to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

disable-zoom-controls-in-pdf.title: Disable Zoom Controls and Set Fixed Zoom Level
disable-zoom-controls-in-pdf.description: Shows how to hide PDF viewer zoom controls and enforce a fixed zoom level using Aspose.Pdf by setting ViewerPreferences and a JavaScript open action.

add-file-attachment-with-creation-date.title: Add Attachment with Timestamp to PDF
add-file-attachment-with-creation-date.description: Shows how to embed a file as an attachment in a PDF and include the current creation date in the attachment description using Aspose.Pdf.

add-xmp-department-metadata-to-pdf.title: Add XMP Department Metadata to PDF
add-xmp-department-metadata-to-pdf.description: Shows how to register a PDF namespace, add a custom XMP metadata field named 'Department' with the value 'Finance', and save the updated PDF.

add-bold-red-centered-text-stamp-page-5.title: Add Bold Red Centered Text Stamp to PDF Page
add-bold-red-centered-text-stamp-page-5.description: Demonstrates how to create a TextStamp with bold, red, centered text and apply it to a specific page (page 5) of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-scaled-image-stamp-from-memory-strea.title: Add Scaled Image Stamp from Memory Stream
add-scaled-image-stamp-from-memory-strea.description: Demonstrates how to create an ImageStamp from a memory stream, scale it to 50% using the Zoom property, and add it to a PDF page with Aspose.Pdf.

fill-pdf-acroform-from-xml.title: Fill AcroForm Fields from XML Using XPath
fill-pdf-acroform-from-xml.description: Demonstrates how to populate PDF AcroForm fields with values extracted from an XML file using XPath queries and the Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form class.

add-green-circle-annotation-to-pdf-page.title: Add Green Circle Annotation to PDF Page 2
add-green-circle-annotation-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to add a circle annotation with a green fill and a 3 pt border to the second page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

embed-memory-stream-as-pdf-attachment.title: Embed Memory Stream as PDF Attachment
embed-memory-stream-as-pdf-attachment.description: Shows how to create a file specification from a MemoryStream and embed it into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's EmbeddedFiles collection.

add-document-attachment-with-description.title: Add File Attachment with Description to PDF
add-document-attachment-with-description.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file as an attachment in a PDF and set a descriptive label using Aspose.Pdf.

add-file-attachment-with-custom-mime.title: Add Custom MIME Type Attachment to PDF
add-file-attachment-with-custom-mime.description: Demonstrates how to attach a file to a PDF and specify a custom MIME type using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-all-attachments-from-pdf.title: Remove All Attachments from PDF
remove-all-attachments-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its embedded file collection, delete each attachment, and save the cleaned document.

add-attachment-preserve-existing.title: Add Attachment to PDF While Preserving Existing Attachments
add-attachment-preserve-existing.description: Demonstrates how to embed a new file into an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf without deleting any previously attached files.

refresh-pdf-attachments.title: Refresh PDF Attachments by Removing and Adding Embedded Files
refresh-pdf-attachments.description: Shows how to delete all existing embedded files from a PDF document and then attach a new set of files using Aspose.Pdf.

attach-network-downloaded-file-to-pdf.title: Attach Downloaded File to PDF as Embedded Attachment
attach-network-downloaded-file-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to download a file into a byte array, create a FileSpecification from it, and embed the file into an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-large-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add Large Attachment to PDF and Monitor Memory Usage
add-large-attachment-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates adding a >10 MB attachment to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and verifying that the process memory consumption stays within a predefined limit.

add-attachment-and-retrieve-name.title: Add Attachment to PDF and Verify File Name
add-attachment-and-retrieve-name.description: Shows how to embed a file as an attachment in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, then retrieve and confirm the attachment's file specification name.

delete-all-pdf-attachments-verify.title: Delete All Attachments from PDF and Verify Count
delete-all-pdf-attachments-verify.description: Loads a PDF, removes every embedded file (attachment) using the EmbeddedFiles collection, saves the document, and then confirms that the attachment count is zero.

add-attachment-and-list-names.title: Add and List Embedded File Attachments in PDF
add-attachment-and-list-names.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, save the document, and then enumerate all embedded file names to verify the addition.

add-unicode-attachment-description-to-pd.title: Add Attachment with Unicode Description to PDF
add-unicode-attachment-description-to-pd.description: Shows how to embed a file into a PDF and assign a Unicode description to the attachment using Aspose.Pdf, then reads back the metadata to verify correct encoding.

add-embedded-file-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add Embedded File Attachment to PDF
add-embedded-file-attachment-to-pdf.description: Shows how to embed a file as an attachment in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by creating a FileSpecification and adding it to the document's EmbeddedFiles collection.

add-attachment-and-store-checksum-metada.title: Add Attachment Checksums to PDF Custom Metadata
add-attachment-and-store-checksum-metada.description: The example iterates over embedded files in a PDF, computes a SHA‑256 checksum for each, and stores the values as custom metadata entries for later integrity verification.

encrypt-pdf-attachment-and-add-to-pdf.title: Encrypt Attachment and Embed in PDF
encrypt-pdf-attachment-and-add-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates encrypting a file with a password using AES, then embedding the encrypted data as an attachment in a PDF and optionally encrypting the PDF itself.

add-attachment-verify-extraction.title: Add and Verify Embedded File Attachment in PDF
add-attachment-verify-extraction.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file into a PDF, extract it back, and compare the extracted content with the original to ensure integrity.

enable-centerwindow-viewer-preference.title: Set CenterWindow Viewer Preference for PDF
enable-centerwindow-viewer-preference.description: Demonstrates how to enable the CenterWindow viewer preference so that a PDF opens centered, using Aspose.Pdf with a dynamic fallback for older library versions.

hide-menubar-viewer-preference.title: Enable HideMenubar Viewer Preference in PDF
hide-menubar-viewer-preference.description: Demonstrates how to set the HideMenubar viewer preference on a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, with a runtime fallback for older library versions.

set-pdf-viewer-preference-fullscreen.title: Set PDF FullScreen Viewer Preference
set-pdf-viewer-preference-fullscreen.description: Shows how to enable the FullScreen viewer preference for a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, with a fallback to a JavaScript OpenAction when the ViewerPreferences property is not available.

set-pdf-viewer-preference-show-outline.title: Set PDF Viewer Preference to Show Outline Panel
set-pdf-viewer-preference-show-outline.description: Demonstrates configuring the PDF viewer's PageMode to UseOutlines so the bookmarks panel opens by default, with a runtime fallback for older Aspose.Pdf versions.

set-multiple-viewer-preferences-pdf.title: Set Multiple Viewer Preferences (Center Window & Hide Toolbar) in PDF
set-multiple-viewer-preferences-pdf.description: Shows how to combine viewer preferences such as CenterWindow and HideToolbar using Aspose.Pdf, with a dynamic fallback for older library versions, and then save the modified PDF.

retrieve-pdf-viewer-preferences.title: Retrieve PDF Viewer Preferences
retrieve-pdf-viewer-preferences.description: Loads a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, accesses the ViewerPreferences settings via dynamic binding to support older library versions, and prints the preference values to the console.

set-hide-menubar-viewer-preference.title: Set HideMenubar Viewer Preference in PDF
set-hide-menubar-viewer-preference.description: Demonstrates how to read the current ViewerPreferences of a PDF, set the HideMenubar flag to true, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

change-pdf-viewer-preferences-save.title: Set PDF Viewer Preferences and Save
change-pdf-viewer-preferences-save.description: Loads an existing PDF, optionally modifies its viewer preferences, and saves the document to a new file.

export-modified-pdf-to-memory-stream.title: Add Text Annotation and Export PDF to MemoryStream
export-modified-pdf-to-memory-stream.description: Loads a PDF, adds a text annotation on the first page, and saves the modified document to a MemoryStream for downstream processing.

hide-pdf-toolbar-viewer-preference.title: Hide PDF Toolbar Using ViewerPreferences
hide-pdf-toolbar-viewer-preference.description: Shows how to set the HideToolbar viewer preference on a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, using dynamic to handle library version differences.

hide-scrollbars-pdf-viewer.title: Enable HideScrollbars Viewer Preference
hide-scrollbars-pdf-viewer.description: Demonstrates how to set the HideScrollbars viewer preference on a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfViewerPreferences class, creating a new PDF with scrollbars hidden for small‑screen devices.

enable-displaydoctitle-viewer-preference.title: Set PDF Viewer Preference to Show Document Title
enable-displaydoctitle-viewer-preference.description: Demonstrates how to enable the DisplayDocTitle viewer preference so the PDF title appears in the window caption, with runtime handling for older Aspose.Pdf library versions.

retrieve-pdf-viewer-preferences-to-xml.title: Export PDF Viewer Preferences to XML
retrieve-pdf-viewer-preferences-to-xml.description: Loads a PDF document, retrieves its ViewerPreferences via reflection, and serializes the preferences object to an XML configuration file.

apply-viewer-preferences-from-json.title: Apply Viewer Preferences to PDFs from JSON Configuration
apply-viewer-preferences-from-json.description: Shows how to read viewer‑preference settings from a JSON file and apply them to each PDF using Aspose.Pdf, employing reflection to stay compatible with different library versions.

hide-toolbar-and-menubar-viewer-preferen.title: Set HideToolbar and HideMenubar Viewer Preferences
hide-toolbar-and-menubar-viewer-preferen.description: Demonstrates how to hide the PDF toolbar and menubar by setting ViewerPreferences.HideToolbar and HideMenubar to true, with a fallback for older Aspose.Pdf versions.

retrieve-verify-incremental-viewer-prefe.title: Merge PDFs and Apply Image Stamp with Viewer Preferences
retrieve-verify-incremental-viewer-prefe.description: Demonstrates merging two PDF files using PdfFileEditor, then adding a semi‑transparent image stamp to every page, and shows how to read viewer preferences after each edit.

set-pdf-viewer-preference-single-page.title: Set PDF Viewer Preference to Single Page Layout
set-pdf-viewer-preference-single-page.description: Loads a PDF, attempts to set the ViewerPreferences.Layout to SinglePage using dynamic and reflection for version‑agnostic compatibility, and saves the modified document.

set-continuous-view-mode.title: Configure Continuous View Mode for PDF
set-continuous-view-mode.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, setting the viewer preferences to continuous scrolling (OneColumn layout) using dynamic and reflection for version‑agnostic support, and saving the updated document.

map-pdf-viewer-preferences-to-toggles.title: Map PDF Viewer Preferences to Interactive Toggles
map-pdf-viewer-preferences-to-toggles.description: Shows how to read, modify, and save PDF viewer preference settings such as toolbar, menubar, window UI, fit mode, and reading direction using Aspose.Pdf with dynamic access and reflection for version‑compatible handling.

toggle-fullscreen-viewer-preference.title: Toggle FullScreen Viewer Preference in PDF
toggle-fullscreen-viewer-preference.description: Shows how to enable or disable the FullScreen viewer preference of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, with reflection to handle different library versions.

apply-viewer-preferences-to-decrypted-pd.title: Apply Viewer Preferences to a Decrypted PDF
apply-viewer-preferences-to-decrypted-pd.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF with a user password, decrypt it, set viewer preferences such as hiding the toolbar, and save the modified document.

export-pdf-viewer-preferences-to-xml.title: Extract PDF Viewer Preferences and Save as XML
export-pdf-viewer-preferences-to-xml.description: Demonstrates how to retrieve viewer preferences from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and serialize them into an XML file for legacy system integration.

hide-pdf-navigation-panels-use-none.title: Set PDF PageMode to Hide Navigation Panels
hide-pdf-navigation-panels-use-none.description: Shows how to set the PageMode viewer preference to UseNone, which hides all navigation panels when the PDF is opened.

add-web-link-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add External Link Annotation to PDF
add-web-link-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert a clickable link annotation that opens an external website when clicked in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-to-specific-page.title: Add Image Stamp to Second Page of PDF
add-image-stamp-to-specific-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create an ImageStamp from an image file, and place it on the second page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-free-text-annotation-helvetica.title: Add Free‑Text Annotation with Custom Appearance to PDF
add-free-text-annotation-helvetica.description: Demonstrates how to add a free‑text annotation to a PDF page using a Helvetica font, size 12, and blue color via Aspose.Pdf.

underline-specific-phrase-page-4.title: Underline Specific Phrase on PDF Page
underline-specific-phrase-page-4.description: Shows how to locate a given phrase on a particular PDF page and add an underline annotation beneath it using Aspose.Pdf.

add-square-annotation-red-border.title: Add Red Square Annotation with Transparency to PDF Page 5
add-square-annotation-red-border.description: Demonstrates how to add a square annotation with a red border and semi‑transparent fill to the fifth page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-batch-text-annotations-to-pdf.title: Add Multiple Text Annotations to a PDF
add-batch-text-annotations-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to batch‑add text annotations to a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf's Document and PdfAnnotationEditor classes.

add-semi-transparent-text-stamp.title: Add Semi-Transparent Text Annotation to PDF
add-semi-transparent-text-stamp.description: Shows how to create a text annotation with 50% opacity and add it to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

set-annotation-opacity-image-stamp.title: Add Text Annotation with Opacity to PDF
set-annotation-opacity-image-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to add a text annotation to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf and set its opacity to 0.75 for a subtle visual effect.

rotate-text-annotation-90-degrees.title: Rotate Text Annotation by 90 Degrees
rotate-text-annotation-90-degrees.description: Shows how to add a text stamp as an annotation, rotate it 90 degrees, position it at the center of a PDF page, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-text-annotation-thick-border.title: Add Square Annotation with Custom Border to PDF
add-text-annotation-thick-border.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a square annotation, set its border color and a custom thickness of three points, and save the updated document.

create-dashed-rectangle-annotation.title: Create Dashed Border for Rectangle Annotation
create-dashed-rectangle-annotation.description: Shows how to add a square (rectangle) annotation with a dashed border to a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

set-light-gray-background-for-text-annot.title: Add Text Annotation with Light Gray Background
set-light-gray-background-for-text-annot.description: Demonstrates how to add a TextAnnotation to a PDF page and set a light‑gray border to simulate a background for better readability on dark pages.

rotate-stamp-annotation-90-degrees.title: Rotate Stamp Annotation 90 Degrees Clockwise
rotate-stamp-annotation-90-degrees.description: Demonstrates how to rotate a stamp annotation by 90° clockwise, align it with an underlying image, and make the visual part invisible before saving the PDF.

add-file-attachment-annotation.title: Add File Attachment Link Annotation to PDF
add-file-attachment-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to attach a file to a PDF and create a clickable file‑attachment annotation that opens the attached file when clicked, using Aspose.Pdf.

add-javascript-alert-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add JavaScript Alert Annotation to PDF
add-javascript-alert-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed a document‑level JavaScript action and a page‑level LinkAnnotation that triggers an alert when activated, using Aspose.Pdf.

add-tooltip-annotation-to-pdf.title: Create Tooltip Annotation in PDF
add-tooltip-annotation-to-pdf.description: Loads an existing PDF, adds a TextAnnotation that displays a tooltip on mouse hover, and saves the modified document.

add-popup-annotation-with-bullet-list.title: Add Popup Annotation with Bullet List to PDF
add-popup-annotation-with-bullet-list.description: Demonstrates creating a multi‑line TextAnnotation with bullet points and linking it to a PopupAnnotation in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-45-degree-rotation-to-stamp.title: Apply 45° Rotation to Text Stamp on PDF Pages
apply-45-degree-rotation-to-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to create a TextStamp, rotate it 45 degrees for diagonal placement, and add it centered to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-rtl-text-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add Right-to-Left Text Annotation to PDF
add-rtl-text-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a TextAnnotation with Arabic (right‑to‑left) Unicode content, and saving the annotated document.

add-red-highlight-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add Red Border Square Annotation to PDF
add-red-highlight-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a square annotation with a bright red border, and saving the updated document.

add-text-annotation-with-custom-author.title: Add Text Annotation with Author Metadata to PDF
add-text-annotation-with-custom-author.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a text annotation that includes author metadata, adding it to a page, and saving the updated document.

add-text-annotation-with-utc-timestamp.title: Add Text Annotation with UTC Creation Date
add-text-annotation-with-utc-timestamp.description: Shows how to add a TextAnnotation to a PDF page and set its CreationDate to the current UTC time using Aspose.Pdf.

add-subject-to-text-annotation.title: Assign Subject to PDF Text Annotation
add-subject-to-text-annotation.description: Loads a PDF, creates a TextAnnotation on the first page, sets its Title, Subject, and Contents, adds it to the page's annotation collection, and saves the updated document.

lock-text-annotation.title: Create and Lock a Text Annotation in PDF
lock-text-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to add a text annotation to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf and lock it with AnnotationFlags.Locked so end users cannot modify it.

hide-annotations-when-fullscreen.title: Hide Annotations When FullScreen Viewer Preference Is Enabled
hide-annotations-when-fullscreen.description: Loads a PDF, attempts to enable the FullScreen viewer preference (if supported), hides all annotations on each page by setting the Hidden flag, and saves the modified document.

replace-text-preserve-font-style.title: Replace Text on Specific PDF Page Preserving Font
replace-text-preserve-font-style.description: Demonstrates how to locate and replace a text string on page two of a PDF while keeping the original font and style using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-text-on-specific-pdf-page.title: Replace Text on a Specific PDF Page
replace-text-on-specific-pdf-page.description: Shows how to locate and replace a string only on a given page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TextFragmentAbsorber.

replace-phrase-bold-preserve-font-size.title: Replace Phrase and Apply Bold Style in PDF
replace-phrase-bold-preserve-font-size.description: Demonstrates how to locate a specific phrase in a PDF, replace it with new text, and apply bold formatting while preserving the original font size using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-blank-page-add-header.title: Insert Blank Page and Header Annotation
insert-blank-page-add-header.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, inserting a new blank page at a specific position, adding a text annotation as a header on that page, and saving the updated document.

delete-page-from-pdf.title: Delete Page from PDF Document
delete-page-from-pdf.description: Loads a PDF file, validates a page number, deletes the specified page, and saves the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

move-last-page-to-beginning.title: Move Last PDF Page to Beginning
move-last-page-to-beginning.description: Shows how to reorder a PDF by moving the last page to the first position using Aspose.Pdf.

add-annotation-and-merge-pdfs.title: Add Annotation and Merge PDFs
add-annotation-and-merge-pdfs.description: Shows how to add a text annotation to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and then concatenate the annotated file with another PDF using the PdfFileEditor facade.

split-pdf-into-single-page-files.title: Split PDF into Single-Page Files Preserving Annotations
split-pdf-into-single-page-files.description: The example loads a PDF that already contains annotations, splits it into individual pages using PdfFileEditor.SplitToPages, and saves each page as a separate PDF while preserving the annotations.

insert-image-annotation-with-caption.title: Add Image with Caption Annotation to PDF
insert-image-annotation-with-caption.description: Demonstrates how to insert an image at specific coordinates in a PDF and place a text annotation caption underneath using Aspose.Pdf.

attach-image-add-stamp-annotation.title: Add Image Attachment and Stamp Annotation to PDF
attach-image-add-stamp-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to embed an image file as an attachment in a PDF and display the same image using a stamp annotation.

batch-add-annotations-from-json.title: Batch Add PDF Annotations from a JSON Definition
batch-add-annotations-from-json.description: Demonstrates reading a JSON file that describes annotation instructions and applying text, link, and stamp annotations to specified PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf.

add-attachment-and-encrypt-pdf.title: Encrypt PDF with Attachment and Viewer Preferences
add-attachment-and-encrypt-pdf.description: Loads an existing PDF, adds an external file as an attachment, optionally configures viewer preferences, encrypts the document with user and owner passwords, and saves the encrypted PDF.

decrypt-edit-reencrypt-pdf.title: Decrypt, Edit, and Re‑encrypt a Password‑Protected PDF
decrypt-edit-reencrypt-pdf.description: Demonstrates opening a PDF with a user password, removing its encryption, modifying its content, and then applying new encryption with specific permissions before saving.

add-file-attachment-to-encrypted-pdf.title: Add File Attachment to Encrypted PDF
add-file-attachment-to-encrypted-pdf.description: Demonstrates opening a password‑protected PDF, embedding a file as an attachment, and saving the document while preserving its encryption.

add-attachment-to-multiple-pdfs.title: Add Attachment to Multiple PDFs in Batch
add-attachment-to-multiple-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to load several PDF files, embed the same external file as an attachment, and save the modified documents using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-viewer-preferences-to-multiple-pdf.title: Apply Viewer Preferences to Multiple PDFs
apply-viewer-preferences-to-multiple-pdf.description: Shows how to loop through a collection of PDF files and set common viewer preferences such as hiding the toolbar and menubar, centering the window, and displaying the document title using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-pdf-pages-in-parallel.title: Parallel Batch PDF Watermarking
rotate-pdf-pages-in-parallel.description: Shows how to process multiple PDF files concurrently with Parallel.ForEach, adding a "Confidential" text stamp to every page and saving the edited documents.

batch-remove-attachments-add-disclaimer.title: Batch Remove Attachments and Add Disclaimer Annotation to PDFs
batch-remove-attachments-add-disclaimer.description: The example loads each PDF in a folder, deletes any embedded file attachments, and adds a standardized disclaimer text annotation on the first page before saving the result.

config-driven-pdf-pipeline-attachments-v.title: Configure PDF: Add Attachments, Set Viewer Preferences, Insert Annotations
config-driven-pdf-pipeline-attachments-v.description: Demonstrates a configuration‑driven pipeline that adds file attachments, applies viewer preferences, and inserts text annotations into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-attachment-and-set-viewer-preference.title: Add Attachment and Set Viewer Preferences in PDF
add-attachment-and-set-viewer-preference.description: Shows how to embed a file as an attachment in a PDF and configure viewer preferences such as hiding the toolbar, menubar, and fitting the window, using Aspose.Pdf with reflection for version compatibility.

async-add-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add Attachment to PDF Asynchronously
async-add-attachment-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates embedding a file into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and executing the operation on a background thread with async/await to keep the UI responsive.

add-large-stream-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add Large Attachment to PDF Using Buffered Stream
add-large-stream-attachment-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to attach a large file to a PDF document while minimizing memory usage by reading the file in buffered chunks.

add-network-attachment-to-pdf-with-retry.title: Add PDF Attachment with Retry Logic
add-network-attachment-to-pdf-with-retry.description: Demonstrates loading an existing PDF, downloading a file via HttpClient with retry on timeout, and embedding it as an attachment using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdf-integrity-sha256.title: Validate PDF Integrity After Inserting a Blank Page
validate-pdf-integrity-sha256.description: Demonstrates inserting a blank page into an existing PDF with Aspose.Pdf and then computing SHA‑256 hashes of the original and edited files to verify whether the document's integrity has changed.

compare-pdf-file-sizes-after-annotation.title: Add Text Stamp to PDF and Compare File Sizes
compare-pdf-file-sizes-after-annotation.description: Loads an existing PDF, adds a red "Edited" text stamp to the first page using Aspose.Pdf, saves the edited file, and then compares the original and edited file sizes to verify that changes were applied.

export-pdf-annotations-to-json.title: Export PDF Annotations to JSON
export-pdf-annotations-to-json.description: Demonstrates how to read all annotations from a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf, collect their details, and serialize the information to a JSON file for external analysis.

import-annotations-from-json.title: Import Annotations from JSON and Apply to PDF
import-annotations-from-json.description: Shows how to read annotation definitions from a JSON file, create TextAnnotation objects, and add them to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

persist-viewer-preferences-after-editing.title: Verify PDF Viewer Preferences Persist After Reopen
persist-viewer-preferences-after-editing.description: The example creates a PDF, sets viewer‑preference flags via reflection, saves the file, reopens it, and asserts that the preferences are retained when supported by the Aspose.Pdf API.

verify-text-annotation-position.title: Verify Text Annotation Position in PDF
verify-text-annotation-position.description: Creates a PDF, adds a TextAnnotation at specific coordinates, then loads the document to assert that the annotation rectangle matches the expected values.

edit-pdf-with-logging-using-pdfcontented.title: Edit PDF with Annotations, Stamps and Logging
edit-pdf-with-logging-using-pdfcontented.description: Demonstrates adding a text annotation and an image stamp to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, while recording each edit operation with a timestamp and file name in a log file.

add-document-attachment-with-error-handl.title: Add File Attachment to PDF with Aspose.Pdf
add-document-attachment-with-error-handl.description: Demonstrates how to embed an external file (e.g., a DOCX) into an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf, including validation of file paths and error handling.

edit-pdf-text-with-pdfcontenteditor-disp.title: Add Text Stamp to PDF with Proper PdfContentEditor Disposal
edit-pdf-text-with-pdfcontenteditor-disp.description: The example loads a PDF, binds a PdfContentEditor, adds a semi‑transparent "Confidential" text stamp to every page using the Document API, saves the result, and ensures the PdfContentEditor is disposed in a finally block to avoid memory leaks.

replace-text-pdf-using-pdfcontenteditor.title: Add Text Annotation to PDF Using PdfContentEditor
replace-text-pdf-using-pdfcontenteditor.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding a text annotation with PdfContentEditor, and saving the edited file while automatically disposing the editor via a using block.

simple-pdf-editing-wrapper.title: Simplified PDF Editing Wrapper with Aspose.Pdf
simple-pdf-editing-wrapper.description: Demonstrates a PdfEditor class that wraps Aspose.Pdf to load a PDF, add text, images, stamps, delete or insert pages, and save the document.

add-pdf-attachment-with-custom-mime-type.title: Add PDF Attachment with Custom MIME Type
add-pdf-attachment-with-custom-mime-type.description: Demonstrates how to embed a PDF file as an attachment in another PDF, setting a custom MIME type and description using Aspose.Pdf.

add-js-action-change-page-bg-on-mouse-ov.title: Add JavaScript Action to Change Page Background on Mouse Over
add-js-action-change-page-bg-on-mouse-ov.description: Demonstrates how to attach a JavaScript action to a link annotation that changes the PDF page background color when the mouse enters the annotation area.

extract-images-from-pdf__v3.title: Extract Images from PDF using Aspose.Pdf Facades
extract-images-from-pdf__v3.description: Demonstrates how to extract all embedded images from a PDF file and save them to a specified folder using the Aspose.Pdf.Facades PdfExtractor class.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v3.title: Add File Attachment to PDF with Description
add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v3.description: Shows how to embed an external file (Terms.pdf) into an existing PDF and assign a human‑readable description using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-extract-images-from-pdfs__v2.title: Batch Extract Images from PDFs to Subfolders
batch-extract-images-from-pdfs__v2.description: Shows how to loop through PDF files in a directory, use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all embedded images, and save each image into a dedicated subfolder named after the source PDF.

add-rotated-image-stamp-to-pdf__v2.title: Add Rotated Image Stamp to PDF
add-rotated-image-stamp-to-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp at specific coordinates, rotate it 45 degrees, and set its opacity to 80% using Aspose.Pdf.

fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json__v2.title: Populate PDF Form Fields from JSON Configuration
fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json__v2.description: Demonstrates how to read default field values from a JSON file and apply them to a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFormEditor before user interaction.

add-image-stamp-to-pdf-page__v2.title: Add Image Stamp from URL to PDF Page
add-image-stamp-to-pdf-page__v2.description: Shows how to download an image from an external URL and place it as an ImageStamp on the second page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v4.title: Add File Attachment to PDF
add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v4.description: Shows how to embed a local file as an attachment in an existing PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

attach-multiple-files-to-pdf__v2.title: Attach Multiple Files to a PDF
attach-multiple-files-to-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over a list of files, create FileSpecification objects for each, add them to the document's EmbeddedFiles collection, and save the updated PDF.

add-text-annotation-to-pdf-page__v2.title: Add Text Annotation to PDF Page
add-text-annotation-to-pdf-page__v2.description: Demonstrates how to place a text annotation with custom content at specific coordinates on the first page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-highlight-annotation-to-pdf-page__v2.title: Highlight Text on a Specific PDF Page
add-highlight-annotation-to-pdf-page__v2.description: Shows how to locate a specific text fragment on page 3 of a PDF and apply a yellow highlight annotation using Aspose.Pdf.

add-green-circle-annotation-to-pdf-page_.title: Add Green Circle Annotation to PDF Page
add-green-circle-annotation-to-pdf-page_.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, verifying page 6 exists, creating a circle annotation with a green outline and custom thickness, adding it to the page, and saving the updated document.

add-popup-annotation-to-pdf__v3.title: Add Popup Annotation to PDF
add-popup-annotation-to-pdf__v3.description: Shows how to create a popup annotation that appears as a hover note on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-hyperlink-annotation-to-pdf__v2.title: Add Internal Hyperlink Annotation to PDF
add-hyperlink-annotation-to-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to insert a link annotation that navigates to a specific page within the same PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-text-in-pdf__v2.title: Replace Text in PDF Using PdfContentEditor
replace-text-in-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to replace all occurrences of a specific word in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfContentEditor and save the result.

add-image-to-pdf-using-pdffilemend__v2.title: PDF Edit Operations Using Aspose.Pdf Facades
add-image-to-pdf-using-pdffilemend__v2.description: Demonstrates common PDF editing tasks with Aspose.Pdf.Facades, including merging multiple PDFs, splitting a document into single‑page files, adding an image stamp to every page, and inserting a text annotation on the first page.
